Nutrients

How to read this

Mixed looks at each nutrient over the time your body stores it, from one day for energy to a month for B12, vitamin D, iron, calcium and iodine. Recent days count most. Days you did not log are left out.

Colors show the meal. The line marks 100 %.

Bars show how much of your daily need your day reaches. now added lost below need lost but still covered. The line marks 100 %.

Targets: EFSA reference values for adults, adjusted for vegan eating (zinc high phytate value, omega 3 ALA doubled). Energy: Mifflin St Jeor. Food values are typical averages; check labels. Product data from Open Food Facts (Open Database License). Food icons: Twemoji, CC BY 4.0. Cooked vegetables use typical cooking losses (vitamin C about 35 %, folate about 25 %).
